governance_decisions.statement: Validation is scoped to L02 Activation pedagogy and does not create or promote HNK lexical or grammar authority.
OPI-006 yes/no learner response remains blocked; no yes/no particle or bare-predicate productivity is canonized.
PA remains lexical 'ontem'; OPI-008 and STR005 do not establish generic past, temporal syntax, morphology or DID auxiliary.
PITSA remains controlled loanword only with atomic TS = G30; no productive borrowing grammar is created.
VANI and VANUVALI remain unresolved and excluded; WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN labels remain unchanged; G-ID remains structural authority and Candidate D non-canonical.
If approved, validate only these 72 authored slots and prepare a separate Review-22 source-review gate; do not author Review-22 with the same approval.
